editorial.blurb: RAKKAN Ramen is a warm, thoughtfully executed ramen spot in Uptown where fresh broths and properly cooked noodles make for reliably comforting bowls.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Garnet or Quartz ramen with customizations like swapping chicken chasu for karaage—the kitchen accommodates swaps well. Arrive early on cold days when cravings peak.
